ShowPlasma requires Zombies plus valid main mode plus live lobby. A setModel wrapper hides membername only for PC in-game. Currency values are presentation requests, not grants or purchases.

- `hmh07-lua-follow4:123` (original lines 3615-3674): Stores a ListSetup datasource under the supplied name and returns that name. The owned provider, only when invoked, builds image model rows from each supplied item whose chosen field exists, using current session mode and item-image requests. Passing the provider is distinct from executing it. Returns 0 offline. Online, scans all balance items for matching name, keeps the last match, subtracts a positive supplied adjustment and clamps below zero. It reads the AARPreMatch baseline when that field exists and returns the nonnegative difference. Recovered f59_local1..4 assignments lack local declarations here; no lexical repair is made. Returns without changes when Black Market is disabled. Otherwise loops the selected stream tier items, separates signature-weapon/outfit/gesture properties, rewrites weaponRef/rarity/unlocked/isLootCase, clears moved fields and appends models/properties rows unless the optional name filter rejects them. The local bribe-name predicate is defined then called immediately for each item; it is not a deferred service callback. The optional rarity dvar overrides the computed rarity. The fake-tier path returns currentTier minus three and 200 when the needed model exists. Otherwise uses AARPreMatch tiers/credits, replacing tiers with currentSeasonTiers when present; absent baseline data delegates to GetLootStreamData. Only two values are returned. Fake-tier mode returns currentTier, 800, lootTierMax and 1 when the current-tier model exists. Normal data returns currentTier/currentLootXP/lootTierMax and redeemed skips or 0. A missing progress/currentTier path returns four zeroes. Other child lookups in a present path are not individually guarded. Returns false outside public online play or with Black Market disabled. Otherwise the forced AAR overlay or LootCaseRewardUp returns true; the remaining path compares prematch tier against current tier. It does not grant rewards.
